automation_evidence.quote:
AD-AGENT, an LLMpowered multi-agent framework that automates
end-to-end AD across multivariate, graph, and timeseries data.

metric_evidence.quote:
The LLM’s recommendations substantially exceed the average baseline and closely track the best
performance in most datasets.

summary: Automates anomaly detection pipeline construction (model selection, documentation lookup, code generation and repair) over PyOD, PyGOD and TSLib; the evaluation reports code success rate, selected-model AUROC above the average-model baseline, and cache latency savings, without testing any time series obstacle.
